note: End goal set by the owner 2026-07-30. The monthly and weekly goals below are still an agent draft awaiting his edit — and may be too narrow: they cover one part of responsibility 1 and none of 2, 3 or 4.

end.goal: Dan runs more projects in parallel than one person could, because every project is operated the same proven way and he is never the bottleneck.
end.why: Set by the owner 2026-07-30: ensure all projects are operated consistently, with best practices developed here and shared to every project; own continuous improvement by doing regular external research into new methods of distributed agent work and agent-human collaboration; run regular audits of all projects and share concise actionable findings and recommendations; and keep human communication clear so it saves the founder's time and lets him expand his reach through parallel projects run via agents. Also (2026-07-30): every project, this repo included, must be able to migrate to another AI platform — nothing exclusive to one platform without a clear justification. Reach is the point; the rest are the means.
end.success: A rule learned in one project reaches all of them, and a chat that has read only this repo can run any project correctly without asking how it works. New methods arrive from outside on a deliberate cadence, not by accident. Every project is audited regularly and each audit lands as a short list of findings the owner can act on in minutes. No rule has to be explained twice — and the number of projects he can run in parallel goes up while his hours do not. Moving the whole fleet to another AI platform would be a day of re-pathing, not a rewrite.
end.horizon: ongoing — a standing capability, not a milestone with a date
end.note: Two of the four responsibilities are NOT yet built: regular external research, and a cross-project audit producing findings and recommendations. See docs/STRATEGY.md, 'The two missing capabilities'. Until they exist this end goal is a plan, not a description.

month.goal: Every project runs on goals, so no agent work starts without a reason the owner chose.
